headline: Nigeria Petrol Stock Cover Remains Below Safety Benchmark for Seven Months
summary: Nigeria's petrol stock cover has remained below the 30-day safety benchmark for seven consecutive months amid import reductions and bank credit constraints.
why: A prolonged fuel stock shortfall raises risks of domestic energy supply disruptions and puts pressure on petroleum product prices in Africa's largest oil producer.

impacts.name: Nigerian Energy
impacts.why: Persistent supply deficits can lead to higher domestic fuel prices and transportation costs across the broader economy.
